content: The ELMo approach of BIBREF0 forms contextualized word embeddings based on language model representations without adjusting the actual language model parameters. Specifically, the ELMo module contains a set of parameters INLINEFORM0 to form a linear combination of the INLINEFORM1 layers of the language model: ELMo = INLINEFORM2 where INLINEFORM3 is a learned scalar, INLINEFORM4 is a constant to normalize the INLINEFORM5 to sum to one and INLINEFORM6 is the output of the INLINEFORM7 -th language model layer; the module also considers the input word embeddings of the language model. We also apply layer normalization BIBREF7 to each INLINEFORM8 before computing ELMo vectors.
